_note: WHICH STRIP BECOMES WHICH PANELS. `source` is the strip in art-source/cutscenes/, `name` is the base the panels take under public/assets/cutscenes/, and `panels` is how many the measurement is expected to find -- publish.py fails rather than publishing if the count moves, so a re-export that changes the layout is noticed here instead of on a phone. `measured` is written back by the run and is the record of the cut columns.
